caption.en: A surviving film segment made in Merauke in the mid-1920s.
caption.pmy: Potongan film yang dibuat di Merauke pada pertengahan 1920-an.

context.en: The archive notes that Papuan people were filmed through the ethnographic conventions of the period. Watch links to the official copy rather than rehosting it.
context.pmy: Arsip mencatat bahwa orang Papua direkam dengan cara pandang etnografis pada masa itu. Watch menautkan salinan resmi dan tidak meng-host ulang film ini.

caption.en: Thirty digitised film selections from the 1926 expedition through Yapen, the Mamberamo and the central highlands.
caption.pmy: Tiga puluh pilihan film digital dari ekspedisi 1926 melalui Yapen, Mamberamo, dan pegunungan tengah.

context.en: The Smithsonian keeps the expedition record online and notes that local perspectives are largely absent from the original record. These films remain linked to the institution until reuse rights are cleared.
context.pmy: Smithsonian menyimpan catatan ekspedisi ini secara daring dan mencatat bahwa suara masyarakat setempat hampir tidak ada dalam catatan asli. Film ini tetap ditautkan ke institusi sampai hak penggunaan ulang jelas.

caption.en: Actuality footage of the 1944 Allied landing and advance around Hollandia, Lake Sentani and the airfield.

context.en: The full wartime reel includes material that is not used as an automatic preview. The Australian War Memorial marks the film as public domain; Watch links to the institutional player until a clean delivery copy is prepared.

caption.en: Wartime footage made around Merauke, including patrols, fishing, aircraft and naval activity.
caption.pmy: Rekaman masa perang di sekitar Merauke, termasuk patroli, memancing, pesawat, dan kegiatan laut.

context.en: The Australian War Memorial marks this reel as public domain. It remains on the institutional player until a web derivative is prepared for R2.
context.pmy: Australian War Memorial menandai rekaman ini sebagai domain publik. Untuk sementara film tetap diputar dari sumber resmi sampai turunan web disiapkan untuk R2.

caption.en: A short wartime reel from Noemfoor, including aircraft, transport and air-sea rescue activity.
caption.pmy: Rekaman pendek masa perang dari Noemfoor, termasuk pesawat, transportasi, dan kegiatan penyelamatan udara-laut.

context.en: The Australian War Memorial marks this film as public domain. Watch keeps it on the official player until a curated web copy is prepared.
context.pmy: Australian War Memorial menandai film ini sebagai domain publik. Watch tetap memakai pemutar resmi sampai salinan web yang dikurasi disiapkan.
